chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The servant will remain standing on the Day of Resurrection in front of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, until He asks him about four aspects: Your lifetime, what did you spend it on? Your body, what did you exhaust it for? Your wealth, from where did you earn it and where did you invest it? And [he will be asked] about our love, the Ahl al-Bayt.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The Ahl al-Bayt (Family of the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What are the four questions asked on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, emphasizes that while the first three questions address general accountability for time, health, and wealth, the fourth question specifically highlights the centrality of *al-wala'* (loyalty) to the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia eschatology. The inclusion of this specific query underscores the theological view that love for the Prophet's family is not merely a devotional act but a fundamental criterion for divine judgment and salvation.
